Hi Liam — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

- Objective: get Clearmap trial running in staging with a dedicated pool (1-2 GPUs) and audit logging; initial pilot aimed at the recommendation microservice.
- Action items from your side: procurement to accept the vendor portal invite + upload completed W-9 and ACH details; security to confirm log-retention window (30/90 days) — you mentioned Jenna would lead procurement.
- Action items from our side: I attached a draft SOW (for scope & timeline) and a template W-9 for your finance team. I can also initiate the vendor portal invite once we have the vendor contact for uploads.

Can you confirm who I should address the portal invite to (procurement contact + email) and whether the onboarding window still looks like early June? If priority has shifted we can adjust.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW-draft.docx (docx), Clearmap_W9.pdf (pdf)

Best,

Subject: Friendly nudge: vendor portal invite + doc checklist (W-9/ACH)

Hi Jenna — following up on Liam's intro. We want to make the portal upload as painless as possible. Quick checklist to get you across the finish line:

- Accept portal invite (sent from vendor-portal@redwoodinference.com)
- Upload completed W-9 (Clearmap_W9.pdf)
- Enter ACH details (or let us know if you'd prefer invoice/PO flow)
- Confirm expected date for security review (log retention + IP controls)

If your priority shifted and you need to delay the pilot, tell us and we'll adjust the start date. If it's still a go, can procurement finish the portal acceptance by EOD Friday (6/4)? Ben and Marissa are on copy to support any operational friction.

If it's helpful, I can jump on a 15-min call with Jenna and Ben to walk through the portal screens — what works for you?

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi Jenna — Marissa on the CS/Onboarding side here. Karthik looped us in — I'm standing by to remove any blockers. A couple of notes from experience with similar customers: 

- If procurement isn't seeing the portal invite, check spam and look for an invite from vendor-portal@redwoodinference.com. We can resend immediately.
- If your finance team prefers not to share ACH over the portal, we can accept ACH via a secure DocuSign envelope or switch to invoice/PO for the pilot period.
- For the W-9: if you prefer, we can accept a signed copy via email and I'll mark it as received so the portal flow continues.

I can do a 15-min screen share tomorrow (6/4) at 10am PT to walk the procurement contact through the portal. If that works, Karthik/Ben — can you confirm? Jenna — what time works for you?

Cheers,
